create_masked_tensor: create a MaskedTensor wrapping a PyTorch tensor with a boolean mask for masked operations
test_is_masked_tensor: test whether a given object is a MaskedTensor instance
get_masked_tensor_data: get the underlying data tensor from a MaskedTensor with autograd support
get_masked_tensor_mask: get the boolean mask tensor from a MaskedTensor
convert_masked_tensor_to_tensor: convert a MaskedTensor to a regular tensor by filling masked values with a specified value
